external_entities.name: player
external_entities.description: A person playing the game on their own machine.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

external_entities.name: customer support
external_entities.description: Staff member who reviews and acts on player accounts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network and use a moderation website

processes.name: game client
processes.description: The game client, running on hardware the operator does not control.
processes.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

processes.name: lobby
processes.description: Matchmaking service that clients connect to and that hands matches to the game servers.
processes.source_excerpt: It talks to the lobby on TCP 1234 for matchmaking

processes.name: game servers
processes.description: Match servers that clients connect to directly and that record match outcomes.
processes.source_excerpt: once a match starts it talks directly to the game servers on TCP 1235

processes.name: moderation website
processes.description: Internal tool used by customer support to view and act on player accounts.
processes.source_excerpt: use a moderation website to look at and act on player accounts

data_stores.name: player database
data_stores.description: Player accounts, written by the game servers and the moderation website and read by the lobby.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match

data_stores.name: stats database
data_stores.description: Match statistics written during and after a match.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The game servers read and write the stats database during and after a match

data_flows.name: launch and play
data_flows.description: Player launches the client and plays through it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The player launches the client and plays through it.

data_flows.name: matchmaking
data_flows.description: Client connects out to the lobby to be placed in a match.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It talks to the lobby on TCP 1234 for matchmaking

data_flows.name: gameplay traffic
data_flows.description: Client connects directly to the match server for the duration of a match.
data_flows.source_excerpt: once a match starts it talks directly to the game servers on TCP 1235

data_flows.name: hand over match
data_flows.description: Lobby hands a formed match to a game server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: hands the match over to the game servers

data_flows.name: read players
data_flows.description: Lobby reads player records to form a match.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match

data_flows.name: read write stats
data_flows.source_excerpt: The game servers read and write the stats database during and after a match

data_flows.name: update players
data_flows.description: Game servers write match outcomes back onto player records.
data_flows.source_excerpt: they also write back to the player database

data_flows.name: moderate accounts
data_flows.description: Support staff review and act on player accounts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: customer support staff work from the corporate network and use a moderation website

data_flows.name: read write players
data_flows.description: Moderation website reads and writes player records directly.
data_flows.source_excerpt: That website reads and writes the player database directly.
data_flows.data_description: player account records and moderation state

trust_boundaries.name: player local machine
trust_boundaries.description: Hardware owned by the player; outside the operator's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

trust_boundaries.name: corp network
trust_boundaries.description: Corporate network where customer support staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: prod network
trust_boundaries.description: Production network holding the lobby, the game servers, the moderation website and both databases.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The client connects out to two things in our production network.

assumptions.assumption: The lobby and the game servers accept connections from arbitrary networks.
assumptions.basis: Stated to be reachable "from wherever a player is, so they are exposed".
Described as player accounts acted on by customer support moderation.
